description.text: Nova is a leading innovator and key provider of metrology solutions for advanced process control used in semiconductor manufacturing. Nova delivers continuous innovation by providing high-performance metrology solutions for effective process control throughout the semiconductor fabrication process. We bring pioneering metrology solutions to semiconductors process control, by industrializing lab and research-grade technologies and developing emerging metrology solutions. Nova’s product portfolio, deployed at the world’s largest integrated-circuit manufacturers, combines high-precision hardware and cutting-edge software, and provides its customers with deep insight into the development and production of the most advanced semiconductor devices. Nova’s capability to deliver innovative Optical, X-ray, SIMS and Chemical analysis technology solutions enables its customers to improve performance, enhance product yields and accelerate time to market.

about.description_short: Nova is a leading innovator and key provider of material, optical and chemical solutions for advanced metrology and process control in semiconductor manufacturing. Nova delivers continuous innovation by providing state-of-the-art, high-performance solutions for effective process control throughout the semiconductor fabrication lifecycle. Nova's product portfolio, which combines high-precision hardware and cutting-edge software, provides its customers with deep insight into developing and producing the most advanced semiconductor devices. Nova's unique capability to deliver innovative solutions enables its customers to improve performance, enhance product yields, and accelerate time to market. Nova acts as a partner to semiconductor manufacturers from its offices worldwide.

analysis_md:
# NVMI — Nova Ltd.
Engine 5.4.0 pass-1 run, 2026-10-18. Price $321.20 (nasdaq_quote_api, key_numbers.md). **In scope:** the engine's market_cap_est prints $10.5M, but that is the share-scale artifact documented in OVERRIDE below; the traded market cap is ~$10.2B (Kraken quote page: market cap $10.22B, shares outstanding 31.81M; Finnhub: $10.28B) — under the $40B scope line either way.

All figures below are copied from key_numbers.md, dcf_numbers.json, ttm.py output, fundamentals.json, statements.json, segments.json, street.json, or a cited search result — none are recomputed. Where the engine's per-share figures carry the thousands share scale, they are labelled "as printed" and the corrected figure is the base_override construction in OVERRIDE.

## What it is
Israeli semiconductor metrology and process-control equipment maker (Rehovot; Nasdaq + TASE, ordinary shares). Dimensional, materials and chemical metrology for advanced logic, memory and advanced packaging — the measurement layer fabs need as Gate-All-Around (GAA) transistors and advanced packaging raise metrology intensity per wafer. FY2025 revenue $880,577,000 (statements.json): Product $705,598,000 (80.1% of total) / Service $174,979,000 (19.9%) (segments.json). One operating segment. Latest quarter (Q2 2026, 6-K earnings release, search-cited): record revenue $254,958,000, +16% YoY and +8% sequentially; GAAP net income $75,010,000; GAAP diluted EPS $2.20; gross margin 57% GAAP. Management guided Q3 2026 revenue to $277M–$287M (search-cited) and authorized a $200M share repurchase program on September 2, 2026 (search-cited).

## Owner's earnings
**FY2025 (20-F via EDGAR, from financials_history.csv):** operating cash flow $245,613,000; capex $27,698,000; SBC $26,291,000 (always a real cost — here a modest ~11% of OCF).
- **Conservative owner's earnings FY2025: $191,624,000** (OCF − capex − SBC). On the corrected share scale (see OVERRIDE) that is the latest-FY figure behind the base: the engine prints latest FY OE/share as $5,842.20 as printed / $5.84 corrected.
- Maintenance version (NI + D&A − min(capex, D&A) − ΔNWC): **−$356,642,000 as printed in financials_history.csv — rejected.** Its ΔNWC leg ($615,865,000 as printed) is swollen by the FY2025 placement of the $750,000,000 convertible-note proceeds (statements.json cash flow: debt issued $750,000,000) into bank deposits and marketable securities — a financing/investing placement, not operating working capital. The OCF-based conservative figure is the clean one here.
- OE positive 5 of the last 5 fiscal years (key_numbers.md). OE totals were essentially flat FY2024→FY2025 ($192,842,000 → $191,624,000, financials_history.csv) despite revenue +30.96% — OCF grew only $235,266,000 → $245,613,000 as the business absorbed growth working capital. Per-share OE on the corrected scale swung $2.74 (FY2023) → $6.00 (FY2024) → $5.84 (FY2025): this is a cyclical OE series, not a smooth compounder.
- Corrected per-share history note: every per-share figure the engine prints for FY2021 onward is 1,000x too large (thousands share scale, OVERRIDE). Totals (OCF, OE, revenue) are filed in dollars and are unaffected.

**Base used = the engine's normalized base (median of last 3 FY OE/share), corrected: $5.84/share** (base_override, OVERRIDE section; key_numbers.md: base OE/share $5.84, source agent_supplied_ttm_override — the pin mechanism label; the construction is the median correction, not a TTM figure).
- **STALE_FY / TTM:** ttm.py cannot run on this filer — it exited non-zero with "ocf: no annual (FY) fact; sbc: no annual (FY) fact; shares_diluted: no annual (FY) fact" (20-F filer; its companyfacts assembly path does not build the annual legs). Per the worker spec for such filers, the median base is used and that is stated here plainly. Interim evidence that the median base is not stale economics: H1 2026 net income was $144,269,000 vs $133,114,000 in H1 2025, on revenue of $490,266,000 vs $433,345,000 (Q2 2026 release, search-cited) — growth continued, but at +13–16%, well below the FY2025 print.

## OVERRIDE — base (share-scale correction) and ads_ratio
- **The defect (worker-caught; the eighth instance of the SHARE_BASIS_SPEC_DRAFT.md family):** Nova presents weighted-average share counts **in thousands**. From FY2021 the EDGAR diluted-share facts are thousands-scaled (29,816 for FY2021; 32,800 for FY2025) while FY2016–FY2020 are in units (27,503,497–28,949,739) — the break is visible directly in financials_history.csv. The engine read the thousands figures as units, so the preliminary run printed base OE/share of $5,842.20, a market cap of $10,535,360, a fake **Tier S** and an IRR pinned at the 200% solver cap (IRR_CAPPED flag) with weighted IV@15 of $143,079.80 as printed. None of that was economics.
- **Cross-checks that the scale is exactly 1,000x:** (1) FY2025 diluted EPS as filed is $7.96 (fundamentals.json / statements.json) on net income of $259,223,000 — that reconciles only at ~32.8 million diluted shares, not 32,800. (2) fundamentals.json reports shares outstanding in units: 31,780,111 at FY2025 (20-F filed 2026-02-17), vs the engine's dei figure of 29,278,401 at FY2024 — the same ~30M order. (3) The company's own releases label the counts "(in thousands)": Q2 2026 diluted shares used in EPS 34,450 (in thousands); Q2 2025 32,053 (in thousands) (search-cited releases).
- **The decision (bounded authority, step 8(c)):** judgment.json carries `base_override = {value: 5.842195121951219, kind: "estimate", source: "This run's dcf_numbers.json base_oe_normalized_per_share ($5,842.195121951219) divided by 1,000 …", reason: "…"}` — built exclusively from this run's computed output. All three median years (FY2023–25: 32,089 / 32,138 / 32,800) carry the same thousands scale and every OE leg is filed in dollars, so the division corrects the median exactly. A `shares_override` cannot fix this: overrides fill only absent periods and never replace filed values (the NTNX/TEM precedent). The final engine run pins the base via `--base-oe-ps 5.842195121951219`, and make_score.py verified the pin matches the declared base_override. Both the base_override and the ads_ratio are recorded in score.json's registry trail (_system/overrides_registry.json).
- **Measured impact:** base OE/share $5,842.20 as printed → $5.84 corrected; the verdict moves from the fake Tier S at the 200% IRR cap (preliminary run) to **Tier D, weighted IRR 7.86%**. The engine's market_cap_est ($10.5M in key_numbers.md) remains the corrupted artifact — scope is unaffected (real cap ~$10.2B, above) and no other engine output uses it.
- **ads_ratio (step 8(d)):** judgment.json carries `ads_ratio = {ratio: 1.0, …}` sourced to the FY2025 20-F (filed 2026-02-17), Item 9.A/9.C: Nova's ordinary shares themselves trade on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under NVMI and on the TASE. There is no ADS program; the traded price is per ordinary share, so no scaling applies (the ESLT/ALC ratio-1.0 precedent).

## Moat: 6/10 — moderate-strong, not wide
Justification: tool-of-record metrology positions at all four GAA players, #2 share (~25%) in film/CD metrology with ~400bp of 2025 share gains, gross margins of 55.5–57.6% across FY2021–25 and roic_proxy of 18.1–33.8% over FY2020–25 — returns above the cost of capital through the FY2023 down year as well as the upcycle — capped at 6 because ROIC has drifted from the high-20s to ~20%, Nova is a niche player against KLA/Applied Materials scale, and demand is geared to a handful of customers' capex cycles.
- FOR: Tool-of-record qualification stickiness — partner for all four GAA players; WMC platform selected as tool of record by a leading global foundry for advanced-packaging flows (Q2 2026 reporting, search-cited); qualified metrology tools sit inside fab process flows and are costly to displace. Returns through a cycle: roic_proxy (fundamentals.json) 27.6% FY2021, 27.9% FY2022, 18.1% FY2023 (the down year), 20.7% FY2024, 19.6% FY2025. Pricing power: gross margin 55.5–57.6% every year FY2021–25 (fundamentals.json), 57% GAAP in Q2 2026. Share gains: #2 in film and critical-dimension metrology at ~25% share, +~400bp in 2025 (search-cited). Diversified dimensional/materials/chemical portfolio plus the services layer (19.9% of FY2025 revenue, segments.json).
- AGAINST: Niche scale vs KLA (process-control leader) and Applied Materials/ASML R&D budgets. Semi capex cyclicality — revenue fell in FY2023 and corrected OE/share swung $2.74 → $6.00 → $5.84 across FY2023–25. Customer concentration in a few foundry/logic/memory majors.
